eeyore_birthday.title: イーヨーの おたんじょうび

opening.narration: 100エーカーの もりの あきちで、プーが テーブルの ところに すわって いました。
opening.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits at a small wooden table in a forest clearing, thinking with a paw on its chin. On the table are cups, plates and a full honey pot; colorful balloons and a ribbon lie nearby.

honey_gift_committed.narration: プーは、イーヨーへの おくりものを きめました。
honey_gift_committed.prompt: This bear from the reference image holds up a full honey pot with both paws, looking pleased, as if it has just decided this will be a birthday present.

pooh_tastes_honey.narration: プーは、ひとくちだけの つもりで、はちみつの つぼを もちだしました。
pooh_tastes_honey.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits hugging the honey pot and peeks inside it with a small guilty, tempted smile, one paw lifted toward the lid.

pooh_ate_honey.narration: きが つくと、つぼの なかの はちみつは、すっかり なくなって いました。
pooh_ate_honey.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits with an empty honey pot tipped on its side in its lap, a little honey on its paw and mouth, looking surprised and a bit sorry.

story_wrap_up.narration: こうして、イーヨーへの おくりものが きまりました。
story_wrap_up.prompt: This bear from the reference image walks happily through the forest carrying a birthday present for a friend, with a balloon on a string floating above.

participant_presence: The person this bear is with (the reader) is never drawn as a figure: no face, body or hands. They are present only as a soft, faceless gray shadow falling into the scene from the bottom edge, as if the reader were standing just outside the picture.
